title: UNDSS Beira: Buzi River Rising, Helicopter and Boats Tasked

fields.orgName: Harbourlight Relief International — Beira Country Office
fields.systemName: Recorded Line - Security Focal Point Desk

transcript.speaker: UNDSS
transcript.text: Rui, Marta Sitoe from UNDSS Beira. Our channel shows nothing from you yet. If any of your people are out of contact, tell us now. The line is bad, so I will be quick. Here is what we know.

transcript.speaker: UNDSS
transcript.text: The Buzi River is still rising. INGD has a report that the Guara-Guara area is cut. Nothing moving by road past Dondo, you know that already.

transcript.speaker: UNDSS
transcript.text: One UN helicopter is tasked to Buzi this morning for assessment. And INGD has two boats leaving from the Beira fish market quay at about nine o'clock.

transcript.speaker: UNDSS
transcript.text: We can put your staff's last known location into the search picture. But understand me, Rui. This is information sharing. The UN is not responsible for your staff, and I cannot promise you a seat. Not on the helicopter, not on the boats.

transcript.speaker: UNDSS
transcript.text: One more thing. The NGO safety network chat says another INGO's team is sheltering at the Buzi district administration building. They did not say how many, or who. Could yours be there?

transcript.speaker: UNDSS
transcript.text: So. What last known location do you want me to put in, and do you want to request anything for the boats? I need it before eight if it is going to make the nine o'clock quay list.

voiceStyles.UNDSS: Woman in her late 30s, calm and professional, Mozambican Portuguese accent speaking English, speaking quickly over a weak mobile line
voiceStyles.HRI SFP: Man in his 40s, tired, measured, brief replies

instructorNote: Clue inject. Check that the SFP gives a last-known location (Buzi district, 19:40 Thursday radio check-in) without names or route detail, and recognises that under Saving Lives Together HRI's security stays HRI's job. Then check that the SFP advises the CD on a movement request for the boat or helicopter and on the threat level for Buzi, that nobody is sent until the movement is approved, and that the CD says what the movement stop means for national staff in Buzi and Dondo.
